estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a family member with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window or door), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects, people caught mid-movement and not posing, no beautiful composition.

claudio.desc: a 58-year-old Latin American pest-control technician with short curly black hair going gray, a gray-stubbled beard, warm brown eyes and tanned weathered skin, wearing a light khaki short-sleeve work shirt with two chest pockets and clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead

lucia.desc: Lucía, a 38-year-old Latin American woman with long dark wavy hair in a low ponytail, wearing a gray t-shirt and jeans

jorge.desc: Jorge, a stocky 40-year-old Latin American man with short black hair and a trimmed mustache, wearing a navy polo shirt

sofia.desc: Sofía, a 9-year-old Latin American girl with two dark braids, wearing a yellow t-shirt

mateo.desc: Mateo, a 6-year-old Latin American boy with short messy black hair, wearing striped pajamas

bruno.desc: Bruno, a medium-size short-haired caramel-colored mixed-breed dog with a green collar

lugares_fijos.cocina: the kitchen of the Ramírez house: white square wall tiles with a blue-and-white patterned tile strip at eye level, wooden kitchen cabinets, a speckled gray granite countertop, a stainless steel double sink under a window with white iron bars, an older white refrigerator covered with children's crayon drawings held by magnets, a worn beige ceramic floor
lugares_fijos.patio: the small cement back patio of the Ramírez house: a stained cement floor, a low white-painted wall with peeling paint and an open drain channel along its base, a row of terracotta flower pots with saucers along the wall, a black plastic water tank on a rusty metal stand in one corner, a green garden hose, the back of the one-story house with a white door and a barred window
lugares_fijos.cuarto_chicos: the children's bedroom of the Ramírez house: two narrow single beds with striped woven blankets, pale blue walls, a window with white iron bars and a thin curtain, a small wooden nightstand with a lamp, a few toys on the floor, a beige ceramic floor
lugares_fijos.ferreteria: a small neighborhood hardware store in a Latin American town: a glass counter with screws and small items inside, wooden shelves behind full of jars, rolls of mesh and boxes

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, curly black hair going gray, gray-stubbled beard, age and skin tone of the man in the reference photograph. He wears a light khaki short-sleeve work shirt with two chest pockets and clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead.
